_meta.source_of_requirements: The project brief supplied with the task, split into testable lines.

requirements.requirement: Collect, organize and analyse against a full list of requirements
requirements.delivered: This page plus REQUIREMENTS.md; every line points at the page that answers it

requirements.requirement: Create an executive summary outlining important details
As a US citizen, find the best way to get money out of China with the least tax penalties
requirements.delivered: The decision tree on the dashboard and the recommendation on the executive summary; the answer is conditional because the origin of the money is unknown (F-03)

requirements.requirement: Research ways to convert CNY into USD; list as many as possible with pros and cons
requirements.delivered: 15 routes across four categories, each with rule, cap, documents, pros, cons and steps

requirements.requirement: Break down the conversion penalty (what the conversion actually costs)
requirements.delivered: The cost decomposition page: FX margin, commission, cable, full-amount, tax, reporting exposure, prohibited-route range

requirements.requirement: Estimate costs in USD 10,000 increments from USD 10,000 to USD 400,000, in a mobile-friendly table, most important information first
requirements.delivered: Eight 40-row ladders plus a cross-route table; the dashboard opens with total cost and share of the amount

requirements.requirement: Actually estimate the cost of every method and give exact step-by-step instructions
requirements.delivered: A ladder on every route page; routes that cannot be priced carry a blank ladder and a flag instead of an invented number

requirements.requirement: No manual input from the user; work autonomously
requirements.delivered: No question was asked; unknown personal facts are flagged rather than requested

requirements.requirement: Verify line by line from official, trusted sources; no hallucination; provide links for manual review
requirements.delivered: Every value traces to a source id and a URL on the sources page; retrieval notes record what was actually read

requirements.requirement: Review the repository line by line and flag irregularities
requirements.delivered: The repo review page: 12 findings with file references and the action taken

requirements.requirement: Create a GitHub Pages site with a clean landing page and subpages organised by category
requirements.delivered: Root landing page plus 27 pages under /edition-h/docs/, with four category pages

requirements.requirement: A dashboard-style UI that is simple, clean and easy to use
requirements.delivered: Card dashboard, one table per question, all tables scrollable, no client-side dependency

requirements.requirement: Every table row carries a source link; unconfirmed values are blank and flagged
requirements.delivered: Enforced by the verifier, which fails the build on a row without a source or on a zero standing in for an unknown

requirements.requirement: Coordinate with other sessions; do not overwrite their work
requirements.delivered: Claim in COORDINATION.md; all new work under edition-h/; the one shared file changed is the root landing page, logged as an integration decision

requirements.requirement: Open a pull request, merge it without waiting, confirm Pages deploys, record the result
requirements.delivered: Recorded in COORDINATION.md with the PR number, merge commit and Pages result

requirements.requirement: Publish flagged irregularities on a clearly labelled page with source links
requirements.delivered: /edition-h/docs/flagged.html, 26 items, none of which blocks publication
